Definition
[Fourier transform on $L^1$] 1. ch4:4.3.1-def-1\group Fourier Transform For $u\in L^1(\R ^n)$ define \[ \hat u(y)=(2\pi )^{-n/2}\int _{\R ^n}e^{-ix\cdot y}u(x)\, dx, \qquad \check u(y)=(2\pi )^{-n/2}\int _{\R ^n}e^{ix\cdot y}u(x)\, dx. \]
